properties.name: A1652/26 / TFFJ
properties.originalText:
AIP CAR SAM NAM ENR 5.1 - TF-R4 SAINT-BARTHELEMY.
CONDITIONS OF USE AMENDED AS FOLLOWS:
GAT/OAT: ENTRY SUBJECT TO THE PRIOR ESTABLISHMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF
TWO-WAY RADIO COMMUNICATION WITH SAINT BARTH INFORMATION.
MAXIMUM INDICATED AIRSPEED (IAS) WITHIN TF-R4: 140KT.
CARRIAGE AND USE OF TWO-WAY RADIO COMMUNICATION EQUIPMENT MANDATORY.
WHEN ACTIVE, THIS ZONE REPLACES THE PORTIONS OF CLASS C AND G
AIRSPACE WITH WHICH IT INTERFERES. HOWEVER, THE SSR TRANSPONDER
CARRIAGE AND OPERATION REQUIREMENTS APPLICABLE IN THE PORTIONS OF
AIRSPACE REPLACED BY THE ZONE REMAIN APPLICABLE.
ALL OTHER TF-R4 PROVISIONS REMAIN UNCHANGED.
INFO AVBL ON WWW.SIA.AVIATION-CIVILE.GOUV.FR
